headline.id: Menuju karier Internal Audit, Internal Control, Risk Management & Compliance.
headline.en: Building a career in Internal Audit, Internal Controls, Risk Management & Compliance.

bio.id: Saya mahasiswa Manajemen Keuangan di Universitas Darussalam Gontor dengan IPK 3,73 dari 4,00, yang tertarik pada audit internal, pengendalian internal, manajemen risiko, dan kepatuhan. Sebagai Chairperson Sharia Investment Gallery (GIS) UNIDA Gontor, saya memimpin tim 15 orang dan mendukung kegiatan literasi pasar modal syariah bersama stakeholders universitas dan pasar. Peran organisasi saya memperketatkan kemampuan dokumentasi, koordinasi administrasi, komunikasi, dan kerja sama tim. Saat ini saya memperdalam prosedur audit, penilaian risiko, dan dokumentasi audit, serta terbuka untuk magang pada 2027.
bio.en: I am a Financial Management undergraduate at Universitas Darussalam Gontor with a GPA of 3.73 out of 4.00, interested in internal audit, internal controls, risk management, and compliance. As Chairperson of the Sharia Investment Gallery (GIS) at UNIDA Gontor, I lead a 15-member team and support Islamic capital market literacy activities with university and market stakeholders. My organisational roles have strengthened my skills in documentation, administrative coordination, communication, and teamwork. I am currently deepening my knowledge of audit procedures, risk assessment, and audit documentation, and I am open to a 2027 internship.

summary.id: Dasbor analisis fundamental untuk saham Indonesia dengan 7 dimensi scoring dan deteksi sektor.
summary.en: A fundamental analysis dashboard for Indonesian equities with 7 scoring dimensions and sector detection.

detail.id: Alat analisis yang menyederhanakan data pasar modal Indonesia menjadi skor yang bisa dibaca dalam hitungan detik. Setiap bobot dan ambang batas scoring menyesuaikan karakteristik sektor bisnisnya, dan modul deteksi risiko dipisahkan dari skor utama. Dipublikasikan di TradingView Public Library.
detail.en: An analysis tool that reduces complex Indonesian market data into a score readable in seconds. Scoring weights and thresholds adapt to each business sector, and the risk-detection module is kept separate from the main score. Published on the TradingView Public Library.

problem.id: Membaca fundamental saham Indonesia di TradingView berarti menimbun puluhan baris data, dan tiap sektor punya karakteristik berbeda sehingga skor generik menyesatkan.
problem.en: Reading Indonesian equity fundamentals in TradingView means stacking dozens of data rows, and each sector has different characteristics, so a generic score misleads.

approach.id: Pine Script v6 modular: mesin data pasar, tabel UI, dan mesin scoring dipisah per berkas. Bobot serta ambang tiap dimensi dibuat sector-aware untuk 15 kelas sektor, dan modul deteksi risiko dipisahkan dari skor utama agar tidak tercampur. 96 tes otomatis lewat PineTS dengan CI di GitHub Actions.
approach.en: Modular Pine Script v6: market data engine, UI table, and scoring engine split into separate files. Weights and thresholds for each dimension are sector-aware across 15 sector classes, and the risk-detection module is kept separate from the main score. 96 automated tests via PineTS with CI on GitHub Actions.

result.id: Dipublikasikan di TradingView Public Library, dengan deteksi otomatis 175+ ticker di 9 watchlist, dukungan bilingual ID/EN, lima tema warna, dan compact mode.
result.en: Published on the TradingView Public Library, with automatic detection of 175+ tickers across 9 watchlists, bilingual ID/EN support, five colour themes, and a compact mode.

summary.id: Dasbor analisis teknikal 4 dimensi dengan filter multi-timeframe, position sizing, dan webhook.
summary.en: A 4-dimension technical dashboard with multi-timeframe filtering, position sizing, and webhook alerts.

detail.id: Pendamping Papan Instrumen untuk sisi teknikal. Menggabungkan skor trend, momentum, volatilitas, dan volume dengan tiga mode trigger entry, modul manajemen risiko, serta dukungan webhook JSON untuk otomasi alur trading.
detail.en: The technical companion to Papan Instrumen. Combines trend, momentum, volatility, and volume scoring with three entry-trigger modes, a risk-management module, and JSON webhook support for trading automation.

problem.id: Indikator teknikal yang tersedia umumnya memakai ambang generik, sehingga tidak menyesuaikan likuiditas dan karakteristik saham IDX.
problem.en: Available technical indicators generally use generic thresholds, so they do not adjust to the liquidity and characteristics of IDX-listed stocks.

approach.id: Empat dimensi scoring (trend, momentum, volatilitas, volume) dengan tiga mode trigger entry, modul manajemen risiko dan position sizing, filter multi-timeframe, serta alert webhook format JSON. 90 tes PineTS termasuk integrasi full-script, 50 parameter dalam 12 grup settings.
approach.en: Four scoring dimensions (trend, momentum, volatility, volume) with three entry-trigger modes, a risk-management and position-sizing module, a multi-timeframe filter, and JSON-format webhook alerts. 90 PineTS tests including full-script integration, 50 parameters across 12 settings groups.

result.id: v0.2.1-alpha dengan 1.286 baris output, 7 kondisi alert dalam 2 format, dan dokumentasi pengguna EN maupun ID.
result.en: v0.2.1-alpha with 1,286 lines of build output, 7 alert conditions in 2 formats, and user documentation in both EN and ID.

summary.id: Toolchain CLI untuk mem-parse kueri, dan validasi kode Pine Script sebelum dipublikasikan.
summary.en: A CLI toolchain to parse, query, and validate Pine Script code before publishing.

detail.id: Dibangun karena memverifikasi indikator secara manual itu lambat dan rawan. Platform ini mengekstrak AST, menjawab kueri semantik, merakit konteks untuk LLM dengan batas token, lalu menjalankan rangkaian validasi. Dipakai sebagai dependensi oleh kedua dasbor di atas.
detail.en: Built because verifying indicators by hand is slow and error-prone. It extracts the AST, answers semantic queries, assembles LLM context under a token budget, then runs a validation pipeline. Used as a dependency by both dashboards above.

problem.id: Verifikasi indikator Pine Script secara manual lambat dan rawan salah, dan membaca ulang kode untuk menjawab pertanyaan yang sama berulang sekali-item adalah waktu yang terbuang.
problem.en: Verifying Pine Script indicators by hand is slow and error-prone, and re-reading code to answer the same recurring questions wastes time.

approach.id: CLI Python di atas parser ANTLR: ekstraksi AST ke pine_semantic.json, mesin kueri semantik (search, context, callers, callees, impact), perakit konteks LLM dengan batas token, lalu pipeline validasi berjenjang (parser, schema, graph, golden). 7 perintah CLI, versi semver, golden test.
approach.en: A Python CLI on top of an ANTLR parser: AST extraction into pine_semantic.json, a semantic query engine (search, context, callers, callees, impact), LLM context assembly under a token budget, then a staged validation pipeline (parser, schema, graph, golden). 7 CLI commands, semantic versioning, golden tests.

result.id: v2.0.0 dan dipakai sebagai dependensi oleh kedua dasbor di atas, dengan 6 Architecture Decision Record terdokumentasi.
result.en: v2.0.0, used as a dependency by both dashboards above, with 6 documented Architecture Decision Records.
